{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABbkGhpA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhFH-a4", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 77, "title": "Add a synchronized Physics On/Off control to the public Uka and Gene Light comparisons", "body": "## User request

Add a simple **Physics** On/Off control to the **public Uka / Gene Light MMD vs glTF comparison**, next to the existing **IK** control. The control should genuinely execute PMX rigid-body/joint physics in **both independently rendered panes**, not just change a label. Use one canonical VMD clock and comparable model/source settings.

- **Off (default):** preserve the current, solver-free-physics behavior. No Bullet/Ammo world created merely to render the page or play a clip.
- **On:** run the actual model's applicable PMX rigid bodies and joints, so hair/clothes and other physics-driven parts respond to animation. Preserve the existing separately controllable IK setting.
- Changing Physics must **not reload the PMX, glTF, renderer, camera, textures or single-model multi-animation asset**.
- Preserve the compact public layout (no View preset), Uka/Gene model names, Toon/PBR, Outline, Rest/manual, facial sample, Laugh and Apology, Play/Pause/Restart/seek/Loop and camera orbit.

**Task for designated implementer only.** The issue author is not implementing code, creating a branch, opening a PR or merging.

## Existing source and constraints

Current main baseline when written: `3dfa726aa38992a1f7d5ea17b377c685e839e8b8`.

1. [Public UI](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/index.html): `#comparison-ik` is present, but **Physics** is absent.
2. [Public playback](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts) currently imports exact retained `VMDPlayer`s, runs a direct PMX `AnimationMixer`, then optional `comparisonIK` on reference/Toon/PBR. It explicitly rejects glTF `MMD_physics` / `MMD_skeleton_solver` payloads and reports `execution.physics:false`, `physics off`. This guard must be replaced with explicit validation, not simply removed.
3. [Asset generation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/prepare-uka.ts) and [Gene asset generation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/prepare-example.ts) both call `convertModel(..., {mode:'bdef', solver:'none', physics:'none', vmds:[...]})`. Their **one character model / three named VMD animations** design and exact source bytes must survive.
4. [PMX→glTF conversion](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/pmx-to-gltf.ts), [PMX physics conversion](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/pmx-physics.ts), [physics validation/diagnostics](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/mmd-physics/index.ts), [Bullet world/timeline](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/three-mmd-physics/world.ts) and [three-mmd physics plugin](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/three-mmd-physics/index.ts) already implement a **bounded profile**, validated mostly on synthetic fixtures. This is an integration task for *real* Uka/Gene, not permission to assume that profile executes all their source features.
5. Uka's [source inventory](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-inventory.json) records **164 rigid bodies and 151 joints**, plus **four fixed-axis bones**. [Solver and physics capability notes](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/source-transport.md) distinguish valid retained source from executable profiles and warn about fixed/local axes, ordering, free joint axes and work limits.
6. [Gene ordered grants / IK](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/public-motion.md) have already been made executable by Issue #71 / PR #72. Physics On must not undo that work, apply grants twice, or run the generic solver in addition to the existing preview adapter.
7. [Prior physics conformance](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/physics-validation.md) and [physics design](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/physics.md) cover synthetic modes, constraints, seek/reset and GPU tests; **original Windows MMD parity has not been established**.
8. Real Uka initial load and mobile resource costs are high; see [resource measurements](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-sleeves.md). Issue #73/PR #74 fixed PMX texture URL normalization, but **actual Android Chrome verification remains pending**. Physics must not silently make the Android experience unusable.

## Implementation work

### A. Audit real-model physics execution before choosing the runtime path

- [ ] Reproduce and document the complete **Uka and Gene Light** body/joint counts, original shapes, modes 0/1/2, constraints/limits (including inverted/free axes), collision groups/masks, masses, gravity, bone bindings, PMX deformation layers, append/IK dependencies, and any unsupported soft-body/impulse-morph or special records. Audit source data without editing the pinned PMX.
- [ ] Run the existing `createPhysics` + `physicsDiagnostics` / `solverDiagnostics` and appropriate backend-capability checks on each **real** PMX with appropriate budgets. Record exact blocking diagnostics. In particular assess Uka's **four fixed-axis bones** and any valid joint/free-axis constructs: do not make a valid source file invalid or secretly discard records to pass an executor.
- [ ] Decide and document the minimum robust route to meaningful physical simulation for **both** characters. Extend reusable solver/physics support where required and feasible, preserving source semantics; if some valid features still cannot execute, give an explicit reason, avoid falsely enabling Physics and identify follow-up scope. The deliverable is a working toggle on real demo models, not merely adding an unavailable control.

### B. Physics-aware glTF and direct PMX, same semantics

- [ ] Keep **one model/one skinned scene per character** with the three named VMD animations. Retain original PMX, VMD bytes, source hashes, credits/rights and material/texture identities. Transport actual physics/solver metadata through appropriate `MMD_physics` / `MMD_skeleton_solver` contracts (or a documented, equivalent retained-source runtime binding) without duplicating geometry/texture/animation models or breaking ordinary glTF fallback playback.
- [ ] On the **MMD pane**, use the direct PMX loader's correctly ordered physics pipeline or a verified equivalent, with physically consistent pre-physics VMD/IK/append → simulation → post-physics deformation. On **glTF Toon and PBR**, instantiate independent corresponding physics worlds from the *same* source records and equivalent backend parameters. Do **not** copy poses between panes as a shortcut.
- [ ] Integrate the existing ordered IK and Gene's prerequisite grant with Physics: source phase/layer/index order, relevant VMD per-controller IK switches, appropriate rigid-body bone writeback (including modes 0/1/2), post-physics grants/IK where present, and collision/joint constraints. Both `IK` and `Physics` checkbox states must have **independent, truthful meaning**; explain any profile where an interaction is unsupported, rather than double-running or silently dropping it.
- [ ] Avoid applying the exact retained VMD player and approximate glTF fallback simultaneously. Ensure the physics step uses the raw authored animation at the appropriate timestamps, and preserves supported morph deformation and preview material/outline rendering on both sides.
- [ ] Initialize/loading the pinned Ammo/Bullet browser backend **only on first eligible Physics On** (or another justified lazy-load boundary), verify its expected artifact, display real loading and error states, and guarantee proper teardown/retry. Physics Off should remain lightweight and functional if the backend fails to load.

### C. Controls, clock, determinism and performance

- [ ] Add a single plainly named **Physics** checkbox beside **IK** in the public toolbar; **default Off**, synchronized for left MMD and right glTF, with concise visible diagnostics when unsupported. Do not reintroduce View presets or verbose always-visible explanations. Keep the opt-in synthetic rig controls separate.
- [ ] Physics On while paused must produce a defined pose/state without unexpectedly advancing the VMD clock. Physics Off restores the deterministic raw/IK-only state. Test all four IK×Physics combinations when supported; unsupported combinations must not appear enabled.
- [ ] Use the **one existing absolute timeline** for Play/Pause, Restart, arbitrary forward/backward seek, loop crossing/end, Rest/manual and model/motion changes. Define and test fixed-step stepping, intermediate-frame interpolation/hold policy, reset/replay on backward seek, VMD controller switches and loop reproducibility. No independent pane clocks or accumulated stale native state.
- [ ] Beware that current `PhysicsTimeline.seek(t)` **recreates/replays a native world**; do not naively call this for every animation frame on real 164-body/151-joint Uka. Use bounded incremental forward stepping and checkpoint/replay or an equivalently measured strategy for seeks, with deterministic fallback/error handling. Measure actual CPU time, native allocations and browser memory.
- [ ] Reuse the same loaded PMX / glTF / textures / renderer and per-model animations across Physics and Motion switches, including Toon/PBR material changes. Dispose Ammo worlds, native handles, event listeners, physics registries and per-model resources on Off/model change/page unload; repeated toggling must not leak.
- [ ] Respect resource limits; avoid long main-thread freezes, especially on Android Chrome. If a real model exceeds available device budgets, keep the UI responsive with a diagnostic and allow Off. Don't claim mobile support based only on a 390px desktop viewport.

### D. Real-model and regression evidence

- [ ] Add Node tests for pinned Uka and Gene source/profile identity, supported/unsupported diagnostics, solver constraints, all relevant body/joint bindings, and conversion/load/source retention. Keep existing synthetic conformance.
- [ ] Add real-asset Playwright browser cases for **both Uka and Gene**: clear visible Physics On vs Off differences in hair/clothes or other dynamic regions at specified VMD frames for Laugh/Apology, while the model's ordinary bone/morph motion remains correct. Measure independent PMX, Toon and PBR transforms and rendered pixels, and establish realistic numerical/visual tolerances instead of relying on a checkbox state.
- [ ] Test IK On/Off combined with Physics, Pause/Resume, Restart, seek forward/backward, loop, switching motion A→B→A, switching models, Rest, Toon/PBR, Outline, camera orbit, corrupted/missing backend recovery, unloading and repeated enable/disable. Verify synchronized time and no double-step/double-world. Network/backend fetch count and native lifetime should be measurable.
- [ ] Test default **Physics Off** preserves current desktop/mobile load and all existing comparison checks. Attempt **real Android Chrome** and record device, OS/browser version, performance, memory and outcome; if unavailable, provide a precise manual test plan and explicitly mark Android Physics verification unperformed.
- [ ] Update `docs/public-motion.md`, `docs/source-transport.md`, physics validation documents, README, About & credits and executable diagnostics. Explicitly separate source-data retention, supported runtime simulation, approximate glTF fallback, original-MMD fidelity (unverified), and physical Android testing (unverified unless performed).
- [ ] Run `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, relevant browser Playwright suites, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`; report passes, failures and skips. Keep established accuracy gates, avoid weakening tests to accommodate differences.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A public **Physics** On/Off control appears for **both** Uka and Gene Light; Off initially, unchanged core demo behavior. On runs measurable, correctly ordered real rigid-body/joint simulation symmetrically in the MMD/glTF panes rather than static animation or a visual effect.
- [ ] All actually executed source physics chains/bodies/joints, omissions and performance limits are accurately reported. No false success if real source features are unsupported; failures recover without breaking the rest of the viewer.
- [ ] IK and Physics remain independently switchable with deterministic, synchronized playback/reset/seek/loop and no duplicate VMD/fallback or physics application.
- [ ] No model/scene/renderer/texture reload during toggles or motion switches. Native memory and resource use are bounded; default Off is safe on mobile.
- [ ] Source pins/bytes, one-model/three-animations transport, Uka/Gene attribution and restrictions, material/outline, camera and existing desktop/browser/synthetic tests remain intact.
- [ ] Real Uka and Gene physics animation is demonstrated with quantified joint/pose/pixel evidence; test results and any unresolved native-MMD/Android limitations are documented.
